The '''Grathan weapons lab'''<ref name="SW desc">{{TORcite|type=general|Strange Weapons|Dromund Kaas}} {{C|Mission description}}</ref> was an area within the main compound of the [[Lord Grathan's estate|estate]] of rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]] on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]],<ref name="Kaas" /> several weapons were developed within Grathan's labs, including a [[Unidentified prototype turret|prototype turret]].<ref name="SW">{{TORcite|type=general|Strange Weapons|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The estate, and the weapons lab within it, first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] (MMORPG) by [[BioWare]]<ref name="Kaas" /> released on [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="release">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20111014-1|text=Global Launch for The Old Republic}}</ref>
